description: This file contains utility functions for constructing CSS or selector strings used in locating elements within a web page, specifically for testing purposes. It includes functions for generating selectors based on attributes like test ID, label, alt text, title, placeholder, text, and role, along with a type definition for role options.

methods.name: getByAttributeTextSelector
methods.description: Constructs a selector string for an attribute with specified text or RegExp, escaping the text appropriately.

methods.name: getByTestIdSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating an element by its test ID attribute.

methods.name: getByLabelSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating an element by its label text.

methods.name: getByAltTextSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating an element by its alt text attribute.

methods.name: getByTitleSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating an element by its title attribute.

methods.name: getByPlaceholderSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating an element by its placeholder attribute.

methods.name: getByTextSelector
methods.description: Creates a selector string for locating an element by its visible text.

methods.name: getByRoleSelector
methods.description: Constructs a selector string based on the role and various optional properties like checked, disabled, expanded, etc.
